content:
I can help with many adult sexual health and education topics—things like anatomy, consent, safer sex practices, contraception, STIs, sexual dysfunction, and relationship communication—answered in a factual, non-graphic way.

I can’t create pornographic/erotic content, sext, write explicit sexual fantasies or “how-to” meant to arouse, or discuss anything involving minors.

If you’re 18 or older and have a specific, non-graphic question, feel free to ask.
